verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततः शान्तनवं भीष्मं प्राञ्जलिर्धृतराष्ट्रजः। सह सर्वैर्महीपालैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Then did the son of Dhritarashtra, with clasped hands, along with all these rulers of the earth, say these words to Bhishma, the son of Shantanu.

verses.sanskrit: ऋते सेनाप्रणेतारं पृतना सुमहत्यपि। दीर्यते युद्धमासाद्य पिपीलिकपुटं यथा ॥२॥
verses.english: “Without a (suitable) leader of the army even a large army is broken up when engaged in battle like a swarm of ants.

verses.sanskrit: न हि जातु द्वयोर्बुद्धिः समा भवति कर्हिचित्। शौर्यं च बलनेतॄणां स्पर्धते च परस्परम् ॥३॥
verses.english: The opinions of two seldom agree besides the leaders of hosts are jealous of one another regarding their own prowess.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते च महाप्राज्ञ हैहयानमितौजसः। अभ्ययुर्बाह्मणाः सर्वे समुच्छ्रितकुशध्वजाः ॥४॥
verses.english: It is heard, O you of great wisdom, that all the Brahmanas having assembled together, hoisted up their flag of Kusha and proclaimed war with the Haihayas of immeasurable energy.

verses.sanskrit: तानभ्ययुस्तदा वैश्याः शूद्राश्चैव पितामह। एकतस्तु त्रयो वर्णा एकतः क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥५॥
verses.english: They were joined. O grandfather, by the Vaishyas and Sudras. There were thus on one side three orders and those best among the Kshatriyas on the other.

verses.sanskrit: ततो युद्धेष्वभज्यन्त त्रयो वर्णाः पुनः पुनः। क्षत्रियाश्च जयन्त्येव बहुलं चैकतो बलम् ॥६॥
verses.english: The three orders broke up again and again in the battle that followed and the Kshatriyas were victorious over that large army though they were alone.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते क्षत्रियानेव पप्रच्छुर्द्विजसत्तमाः। तेभ्यः शशंसुर्धर्मज्ञा याथातथ्यं पितामह ॥७॥
verses.english: Then did these best among the twice-born asked the Kshatriya the cause of his and O grandfather, and those men conversant with virtue told them the truth.

verses.sanskrit: वयमेकस्य शृण्वाना महाबुद्धिमतो रणे। भवन्तस्तु पृथक्सर्वे स्वबुद्धिवशवर्तिनः ॥८॥
verses.english: "In battle we listen to the commands of any one person who is the wisest among us, but you are separated and follow your individual whims,

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाश्चक्रुरेकं सेनापतिं द्विजम्। नये सुकुशलं शूरमजयन् क्षत्रियांस्ततः ॥९॥
verses.english: Then did those best among the Brahmanas make one among the twice-born the leader of their army, who was skillful in diplomacy and then did they win a victory ever the Kshatriyas

verses.sanskrit: एवं ये कुशलं शूरं हितेप्सितमकल्मषम्। सेनापतिं प्रकुर्वन्ति ते जयन्ति रणे रिपून् ॥१०॥
verses.english: In the same way those, who appoint a skillful hero who has the good of his party at heart as the leader of the army, vanquish their enemies in battle.

verses.sanskrit: भवानुशनसा तुल्यो हितैषी च सदा मम। असंहार्यः स्थितो धर्मे स नः सेनापतिर्भव ॥११॥
verses.english: You are equal to Ushanas himself and over wish me well and follow a righteous course from which you never fall off. Therefore do you become a general.

verses.sanskrit: रश्मिवतामिवादित्यो वीरुधामिव चन्द्रमाः। कुबेर इव यक्षाणां देवानामिव वासवः ॥१२॥
verses.english: You are as the sun is among the luminous bodies, the moon among deciduous herbs, Kubera among the Yakshas, Vasava among the gods,
verses.bhavadeepa: उशनसा शुक्रेण असंहार्यः पितुर्वरदानात् कालेनापि संहर्तुमशक्यः ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतानां यथा मेरुः सुपर्णः पक्षिणां यथा। कुमार इव देवानां वसूनामिव हव्यवाट् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Meru among the mountains, Suparna among the birds, Kumara among the gods, Indra among the Vasus.

verses.sanskrit: भवता हि वयं गुप्ताः शक्रेणेव दिवौकसः। अनाधृष्या भविष्यामस्त्रिदशानामपि ध्रुवम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Protected by you we will be as the gods protected by Shakra and we shall surely be invincible even by the denizens of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयातु नो भवानग्रे देवानामिव पावकिः। वयं त्वामनुयास्यामः सौरभेया इवर्षभम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: You march in our front as the son of Agni (Kumara) among the gods and we shall follow you like calves following a cow.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत। यथैव हि भवन्तो मे तथैव मम पाण्डवाः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Bhishma said It is as you say, O Bharata, O you of long arms but as you are to me so are the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: अपि चैव मया श्रेयो वाच्यं तेषां नराधिप। संयोद्धव्यं तवार्थाय यथा मे समयः कृतः ॥१७॥
verses.english: And it is also my duty to look after their welfare, O ruler of men; but I shall fight on your behalf since I have promised it.

verses.sanskrit: न तु पश्यामि योद्धारमात्मनः सदृशं भुवि। ऋते तस्मान्नरव्याघ्रात् कुन्तीपुत्राद्धनञ्जयात् ॥१८॥
verses.english: I do not see any soldier equal to me in this world save that best among men Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti.

verses.sanskrit: स हि वेद महाबुद्धिर्दिव्यान्यस्त्राण्यनेकशः। न तु मां विवृतो युद्धे जातु युध्येत पाण्डवः ॥१९॥
verses.english: He (Arjuna) is a man of great wisdom and knows the use of celestial weapons and many other weapons but that son of Pandu will never encounter me in open fight.

verses.sanskrit: अहं चैव क्षणेनैव निर्मनुष्यमिदं जगत्। कुर्यां शस्त्रबलेनैव ससुरासुरराक्षसम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: I, in a moment, shall make this world destitute of men, gods, Asuras and Rakshasas by the strength of my weapons.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वेवोत्सादनीया मे पाण्डोः पुत्रा जनाधिप। तस्माद्योधान् हनिष्यामि प्रयोगेणायुतं सदा ॥२१॥
verses.english: But these sons of Pandu ought not to be slain by me, O ruler of men; therefore shall I slay ten thousand warriors every day.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेषां करिष्यामि निधनं कुरुनन्दन। न चेत्ते मां हनिष्यन्ति पूर्वमेव समागमे ॥२२॥
verses.english: In this way, shall I bring on their end o delighter of the Kuru race, if indeed they do not kill me before I have time to carry out my desire in the battle.
verses.bhavadeepa: न मे मया उत्सादनीयाः नाशयितुं शक्याः सदा प्रत्यहम् ॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: सेनापतिस्त्वहं राजन् समये नापरेण ते। भविष्यामि यथाकामं तन्मे श्रोतुमिहार्हसि ॥२३॥
verses.english: But there is another condition on which I shall be the leader of your army; that desire which I have in my heart it is proper that you should hear of.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णो वा युध्यतां पूर्वमहं वा पृथिवीपते। स्पर्धते हि सदाऽत्यर्थं सूतपुत्रो मया रणे ॥२५॥
verses.english: Either let Karna fight first or myself, O lord of the earth. The son of the Suta always compares his prowess in battle with mine,

verses.sanskrit:
कर्ण उवाच।
              नाहं जीवति गाङ्गेये राजन् योत्स्ये कथञ्चन। हते भीष्मे तु योत्स्यामि सह गाण्डीवधन्वना ॥२६॥
verses.english: Karria said So long as the son of Ganga is alive I shall never fight, O king; when Bhishma is slain, I shall fight with him who wields the Gandiva bow.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततः सेनापतिं चक्रे विधिवद्भूरिदक्षिणम्। धृतराष्ट्रात्मजो भीष्मं सोऽभिषिक्तो व्यरोचत ॥२७॥
verses.english: Drums and conches were then sounded by hundreds and thousands by eager musicians by command of the king,

verses.sanskrit: ततो भेरीश्च शङ्खांश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। वादयामासुरव्यग्रा वादका राजशासनात् ॥२७॥
verses.english: Drums and conches were then sounded by hundreds and thousands by eager musicians by command of the king,

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादाश्च विविधा वाहनानां च निःस्वनाः। प्रादुरासन्ननभ्रे च वर्षं रुधिरकर्दमम् ॥२८॥
verses.english: There were also roars like those of lions and several other sorts of roars among the army; and though there were no clouds in the sky there was a down pour of blood which made the ground full of mire.

verses.sanskrit: निर्घाताः पृथिवीकम्पा गजबृंहितनिःस्वनाः। आसंश्च सर्वयोधानां पातयन्तो मनांस्युत ॥२९॥
verses.english: There were also earthquakes and whirlwinds and roars made by elephants which succeeded in casting a shade on the minds of all warriors.

verses.sanskrit: वाचश्चाप्यशरीरिण्यो दिवश्चोल्काः प्रपेदिरे। शिवाश्च भयवेदिन्यो नेदुर्दीप्ततरा भृशम् ॥३०॥
verses.english: There were also incorporeal voices and meteors shot forth the heavens and jackals began to make frightful howls and the cardinal points seemed ablaze.

verses.sanskrit: सैनापत्ये यदा राजा गाङ्गेयमभिषिक्तवान्। तदैतान्युग्ररूपाणि बभूवुः शतशा नृप ॥३१॥
verses.english: When the king installed the son of Ganga in the generalship these frightful sights appeared in hundreds, O ruler of men.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सेनापतिं कृत्वा भीष्मं परबलार्दनम्। वाचयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान् गोभिर्निष्कैश्च भूरिशः ॥३२॥
verses.english: Then having appointed, Bhishma the grinder of the enemies' hosts, as the general and having made liberal presents of cows and gold to the foremost among the twice born.

verses.sanskrit: वर्धमानो जयाशीर्भिर्निर्ययौ सैनिकैर्वृतः। आपगेयं पुरस्कृत्य भ्रातृभिः सहितस्तदा ॥३३॥
verses.english: He marched forth with the blessings of those Brahmanas glorifying him, surrounded by his army placing Bhishma at the head of his host and accompanied by his brothers.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्धावारेण महता कुरुक्षेत्रं जगाम ह ॥३४॥
verses.english: And with a large army he went to Kurukshetra.

verses.sanskrit: परिक्रम्य कुरुक्षेत्रं कर्णेन सह कौरवः। शिबिरं मापयामास समे देशे जनाधिप ॥३५॥
verses.english: The of Kuru having traversed Kurukshetra in company with Karna placed his camps in a plain, O ruler of men,

verses.sanskrit: मधुरानूषरे देशे प्रभूतयवसेन्धने। यथैव हास्तिनपुरं तद्वच्छिबिरमाबभौ ॥३६॥
verses.english: In a part which was also charming and without sands and abounded, fuel and fodder. The encampment then shone forth as the city of Hastina. son
